_comment: Canonical record history. Edit this file, then run scripts/update_leaderboard.py to regenerate README + RECORDS.md. CI fails if they drift.

records.author: Saivineeth147
records.description: Baseline: plain LoRA r=16 on all linear layers, 3 epochs, cosine LR. No tricks.
records.notes: Seed record at track freeze (tag spec-v1-frozen). 3/3 runs clear the 57.0% target.

records.author: Saivineeth147
records.description: Sequence packing + completion-only loss masking, 2 epochs. Same LoRA config as #0; ~2x faster at higher accuracy.
records.notes: Eliminates the baseline's padding waste (packing) and prompt-token loss (completion-only masking). Adapter identical to #0, so the gain is pure data-pipeline.

records.author: Saivineeth147
records.description: Track 2 baseline: plain LoRA r=16 on SQuAD, first 20k examples, 1 epoch, full-sequence loss. No tricks.
records.notes: Seed record at track 2 freeze (tag spec-t2-frozen). Run 3 (953.4s, seed 350590137) was a Modal volume I/O stall — wall-clock >1.5x the batch median while accuracy stayed normal — so its TIME is dropped from the official mean as infrastructure noise per the infra-outlier rule (its accuracy still counts). Official time is the mean of the two clean runs (523.5, 527.2 -> 525.4s); to be re-run to restore a clean 3-seed timing set. See issue #7.

records.author: Piotr Migdał
records.description: One 4e-4 epoch over 3,000 examples with 2x optimizer updates (integrated-LR), 512-token packs. First outside record.
records.notes: First outside submission. Official rerun (113.0s) beat the self-report (122.2s).

records.author: Piotr Migdał
records.description: Shortest-4k data pruning, 1 aggressive-LR epoch, <<...>> annotations stripped, custom GPU-resident packed loop, chunked completion-only CE (no full logits).
records.notes: Chunked completion-CE never materializes the 151k-vocab logits tensor. 11m57s -> 1m44s in three days across three records and two authors.

records.author: Julien Launay
records.description: 0.75-epoch six-target BF16 LoRA: shortest-4k pruning with down_proj dropped (13.76M params), deterministic best-fit packing, per-layer fused base+LoRA-A q/k/v & gate/up GEMMs, chunked completion-only CE.
records.notes: Builds on #3: drops down_proj from the LoRA targets (18.46M->13.76M params), keeps the adapter in BF16, best-fit repacks #3's next-fit membership into fewer full blocks, fuses each layer's frozen base + shared-input LoRA-A q/k/v and gate/up projections into one GEMM each, and shortens the schedule to 0.75 epoch at 5e-4. First sub-minute record; exposed and fixed a train->eval volume-commit race in the harness. 104.0s -> 43.9s.

records.author: Leah Bacon
records.description: Track 2 port of the Track 1 stack: shortest-4k pruning, best-fit packing, fused base+LoRA-A GEMMs, chunked completion-only CE, 0.75 epoch on SmolLM2-1.7B.
records.notes: Track 2's first outside submission, and the first cross-track port: the Track 1 record #4 stack applied to SmolLM2-1.7B/SQuAD, showing those techniques generalize beyond GSM8K. 525.4s -> 49.5s (-91%). Merged as the submission only: the PR's harness evaluator edits were rejected (unnecessary, and they resolved the model as sorted(snapshots)[-1], bypassing the pinned SHA), as were its hand-written verification report and hand-edited README.

records.author: Julien Launay
records.description: Direct-from-safetensors Qwen load with a warmed page cache, then 12 optimizer updates: 8 full-network, then 4 through only the top decoder layer over a cached BF16 frozen-prefix boundary.
records.notes: Builds on #4: loads the pinned Qwen snapshot directly from safetensors into a meta-constructed model while a background read warms the file, then caps training at 12 updates - 8 full backward passes, then a one-time batched materialization of the frozen lower-27-layer boundary activations (BF16 cache) and 4 updates that backprop only through layer 27. Active params drop 13,271,040 -> 491,520 at the transition while the exported adapter stays a full 13,762,560-param 28-layer PEFT LoRA. 43.9s -> 21.6s (-51%). Thinnest margin yet: run 3 cleared the 57.0% target by 0.09pp (~1.2 problems); see the report.
